text: Applied chemistry is an interdisciplinary field that bridges the gap between chemical theory and practical applications. Its core lies in transforming the basic principles and research methods of chemistry into technologies and products that can solve practical problems in areas such as industrial production, environmental protection, material research, and medical health. It not only focuses on the depth of chemical fundamental theories but also emphasizes practical capabilities guided by "application". It is one of the most closely integrated specialties within the field of chemistry with industries. From daily-use detergents and cosmetics to catalysts in industrial production, new energy materials, and pollutant degradation technologies in environmental governance, all of these are supported by applied chemistry.
